acquisitionPolicy.requestPolicy: bounded manual acquisition of only cited public pages; checked-in normalized numeric facts are the CI input

sources.title: dungeons.tools weapon damage comparison
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
quotedFields: What is not here: an absolute damage number
facts: Weapon items expose relative Power ratings.
The common absolute gear-power curve is compiled into the executable rather than shipped in PAK files.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Powershaker
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: Cooldown is displayed as 10s.
No damage coefficient or absolute damage curve is present in public HTML/client payload.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Artifact damage-family detail pages
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: The bounded damage-family page set exposes qualitative effects and normalized properties but no public absolute Power-to-damage tables or raw coefficient field names.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Harvester
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: Normalized public page displays Cooldown 8s.
The raw source property name and unit are not exposed.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Lightning Rod
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: Normalized public page displays Cooldown 4s.
The bolt lands after a qualitative delay, but no delay value or raw field name is exposed.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Soul Healer
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: Cooldown is displayed as 5s.
No healing curve or random-roll distribution is exported.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Totem of Regeneration
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
facts: Cooldown is displayed as 25s.
Healing is gradual for players inside the aura; duration, ticks and healing curve are absent.

sources.title: dungeons.tools Wind Horn
sources.versionTag: 1.17.0.0 current
quotedFields: Pushes enemies away and slows them briefly
facts: Cooldown is displayed as 10s.
Very close enemies are slowed but not pushed; no numeric slow or high-Power band is exposed.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Powershaker
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric mechanics version unresolved
facts: Effect ends after 15s or five explosions.
No absolute damage table is published.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Harvester
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Page displays 4s cooldown and four damage rows.
The low-Power ranges retain unresolved variable-soul semantics.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Lightning Rod
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Page displays 2s cooldown and seven damage rows at Power 1-114.
The page does not pin the table to 1.17.0.0.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Soul Healer
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Twenty-three Power rows are published as two nested ranges.
History records variable-soul removal, so range semantics cannot be assigned to current fixed-cost behavior.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Totem of Regeneration
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Power 31/111/114 display values are 229/2659/2917.
Display unit, exact duration and tick interval are unstated.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Wind Horn
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Five overlapping bands cover Power 1-108 and reach 8 blocks.
No 109+ cap or slow classification, magnitude or duration is published.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Corrupted Beacon
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Twenty-three damage-per-second ranges cover Power 1-108.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Anchor
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Existing optimizer reference knots include Power 100 = 3699 and Power 125 = 10298.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki Radiance
sources.versionTag: current page; numeric table version unresolved
facts: Tier-I healing samples include Power 75 and 168-254.
This is enchantment healing and has no proven unit lineage to Artifact healing.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki duration samples for Shock Powder, Death Cap Mushroom, Iron Hide Amulet and Totem of Shielding
sources.versionTag: current pages; numeric table versions unresolved
facts: Published families have visibly different fixed, linear and discrete-band behavior.
Fishing Rod and Gong current pages expose no paired numeric table.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki 1.16.2.0 patch transcription
sources.versionTag: known historical version 1.16.2.0
facts: Powershaker 235 to 259; Ice Wand 470 to 600; Scatter Mines 600 to 660; Eye of the Guardian +100%.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki 1.3.2.0 history transcription
sources.versionTag: known historical version 1.3.2.0
facts: Soul Healer fixed cost/cooldown and per-soul healing changed.
Harvester cooldown became 4s and Lightning Rod cooldown became 2s.

sources.title: Minecraft Wiki 1.7.2.0 history transcription
sources.versionTag: known historical version 1.7.2.0
facts: Totem healing changed from 20 to 40 per second.
